purpose: Freeze the exact retrospective development population and source semantics before the preregistered nine-factor Stage-1 screen.

population.membership_rule: official_list_date <= D < official_delist_date; blank delist is open-ended
population.kline_to_canonical_mapping: kline symbol is joined to PIT interval security_code; mapping must be exactly one canonical_security_id per security_code or the run blocks

date_scope.outcome_endpoint_source: same pinned current snapshot for both D and T endpoints

canonical_snapshot_identity.rule: The screen must emit an ordered panel identity hash over canonical_security_id, signal_date, nine factor values, D+5 return and D+10 return after all frozen population filters.
canonical_snapshot_identity.large_panel_storage: Panel bytes may remain reproducibly virtual; immutable source hashes + transformation code + ordered panel SHA256 are the durable identity.
